items.title: Dependabot hints and tricks
items.summary: Practical tips for making Dependabot more effective, reducing dependency-update noise, and improving software supply-chain security.Topics include:- Configuring schedules, PR limits, and versioning strategies.- Grouping dependency updates to reduce PR noise and CI costs.- Using cooldown periods to reduce exposure to malicious or broken releases.- Understanding package provenance and attestations.- Making dependency installations reproducible in CI.- Turning dependency-update failures into automated regression tests.Includes examples, references, and links to useful resources.
